title: MotionSignal
description: DRAFT, not approved (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-26). The motion core's only input from SORA, version 2. Changes from v1: intent gains run, fall and get_up, and null for unknown (v1's neutral value was idle, so idle and unknown were the same); emotion is a keyword from a fixed list (or null) with an intensity, replacing valence and arousal floats, which a small language model can't set reliably (owner, 2026-10-23). Each emotion keyword has a fixed valence/arousal anchor in motion-lab (motionlab/motion_signal.py, EMOTION_ANCHORS). Conversation, attention, audio and context are as v1. Implemented in motion-lab versions/v4.

intent.description: What she is doing; null when unknown.

intent_target.description: A Core-issued window, control or pointer reference, already revalidated.

emotion.description: How she feels; null when unknown.

intensity.description: How strongly the emotion shows; null when unknown.

audio.description: Her own speech envelope for this frame; null while she is silent.

pitch.description: Log-pitch within her voice's range; null when unvoiced.

support_surface_id.description: The taskbar, a window top or an edge she is on.
